why: The documented skip, in PHP's spelling — and now P3's resolution of most of it: `$obj->m()` on a typed property (`$this->handler->run()`) and a typed parameter both resolve via the receiver's declared type (§3.2 rows 7-8); an untyped parameter has no declared type to resolve and stays a permanent miss. Before P3 landed, all three missed in P2 — the identical shape the python/typescript/go/csharp cases exercise, which is what makes the per-language CALLS figures comparable.
